title: USDA Organic Certification
description: Our entire product line is certified organic by the USDA National Organic Program under the supervision of an accredited certifying agent.

title: EU Organic Certification
description: We maintain full EU Organic certification under Regulation (EU) 2018/848, allowing our products to be marketed as organic throughout the European Union.

title: Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP)
description: Our processing and warehousing facilities operate under current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) certification in accordance with 21 CFR Part 111.

title: Fair Trade Certified
description: Our Fair Trade certification ensures that farmers receive fair prices, fair wages, and work under safe conditions.

title: ISO 22000:2018 Food Safety Management
description: Our facilities are certified to ISO 22000:2018, the international standard for food safety management systems.

title: Non-GMO Project Verified
description: Our products are verified by the Non-GMO Project, North America's most rigorous third-party verification program for GMO avoidance.

title: Kosher Certification
description: Our processing facilities and select product lines hold Orthodox Union (OU) Kosher certification.

title: FSSC 22000 Food Safety System
description: We maintain FSSC 22000 certification, a GFSI benchmarked food safety scheme recognized by major global food retailers.
